#### **IsoResponseCode**(RiskManagement.IsoResponseCode)

**IsoResponseCode** is an important response code generated by **Powertranz** or the issuing bank depending on the stage of the transaction.

For example, during 3DS authentication or non payment transactions (Tokenization, Fraud Check etc.), IsoResponseCode shows the final status of the action.

If you have called the payment endpoint to perform a financial transaction, the IsoResponseCode returned in response object shows ISO8583 response code known as the issuing bank response code.

This table shows values for approved or completed transactions depending on integration and endpoint called.

# **Approved or completed transactions**

| **IsoResponseCode** | **Response Message**       | **Details**                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 00                  | Transaction is approved.   | Returned for **Financial Transactions Only**. The transaction is completed.                                                                                          |
| 3D0                 | 3DS complete               | 3DS authentication is completed without errors; you may proceed with the corresponding flow depending on the authentication status.                                  |
| 3D1                 | 3DS not supported          | 3DS2 is not supported for this card. You may proceed with Payment completion although the transaction will proceed as standard e-commerce and not 3DS authenticated. |
| HP0                 | HPP preprocessing complete | The step has been successfully completed, and you may proceed with the corresponding flow.                                                                           |
| TK0                 | Tokenize complete          | The step has been successfully completed, and you may proceed with the corresponding flow.                                                                           |
| SP4                 | SPI Preprocessing complete | The step has been successfully completed, and you may proceed with the corresponding flow.                                                                           |
| FC0                 | Fraud Check complete       | Fraud check completed without errors, and you may proceed with the corresponding flow.                                                                               |
| 3D4                 | Authenticate payer         | For FPI 3DS transactions (if seen for SPI, transaction may have stopped at this stage)                                                                               |
| 3D5                 | Fingerprint payer          | For FPI 3DS transactions (if seen for SPI, transaction may have stopped at this stage)                                                                               |
| 3D6                 | Challenge payer            | For FPI transactions (if seen for SPI, transaction may have stopped at this stage)                                                                                   |

# **Error messages**

In case of an error or decline, **IsoResponseCode** will be returned with a **ResponseCode** and **ResponseMessage** that describes the general reason for the failure and in some cases an error message.

Error messages are contained in the errors object. The errors object can contain one or multiple errors. If you are unsure of the reason for the error(s) received, contact the support team.

**Note**: When a response is returned with an invalid field, you must revisit the API specification for the allowed format on that field. For example, “CardholderName” and Billing and Shipping address fields only allows for certain characters displayed in Data Validation
